intro:
HSR to West Kowloon; chartered van all day
Peak Tram up, Madame Tussauds, lunch at the Peak, van down
Central: Mid-Levels Escalator, Tai Cheong egg tarts, Lan Fong Yuen milk tea
Ding Ding tram to Wan Chai: Kam's roast goose, Capital Café
Star Ferry to Tsim Sha Tsui; souvenirs at Toys"R"Us

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou South Station (广州南站)
Enter station, security check
items.note: Trains to Hong Kong require earlier arrival; 40 min should be allowed.
items.tip: Documents for entering Hong Kong and returning to the mainland must be carried; check once more before leaving.

items.title: HSR: Guangzhou South → Hong Kong West Kowloon (香港西九龙)
items.tip: HSR tickets should be bought as soon as sales open; year-end tickets sell out fast.

items.title: West Kowloon Station border clearance
items.note: Mainland exit and Hong Kong entry are both done inside the station.

items.title: Hong Kong route (chartered van)

route.title: West Kowloon Station → Peak Tram lower terminus (花园道山顶缆车总站)
route.desc: Van, ~20 min via the Western Harbour Crossing
route.pick: West Kowloon Station private-car pick-up area; the level and exit should be confirmed with the driver by WhatsApp after clearance
route.drop: Outside the Peak Tram lower terminus, Garden Road

route.title: Peak Tram (山顶缆车)
route.desc: Century-old funicular; the steep tilt on the way up is thrilling and memorable for kids. Morning queues are shorter than at noon.
route.tip: A Madame Tussauds + Peak Tram combo ticket gives access to a dedicated lane.

route.title: Madame Tussauds Hong Kong (杜莎夫人蜡像馆)
route.desc: Close-up photos with wax figures of celebrities and athletes; a favourite with kids.

route.title: Lunch at the Peak
route.walk: The Peak Tower and Peak Galleria (山顶广场)
route.desc: Kept light, to leave room for the roast goose later.
route.tip: Which restaurants are open at the Peak should be checked on the day.

food.name: Restaurants in The Peak Tower (凌霄阁)
food.desc: Bubba Gump, Burger King and others

route.title: Victoria Peak (太平山顶)
route.desc: Views over Victoria Harbour and all of Hong Kong Island.

route.title: Van down the Peak → Central
route.desc: ~20 min; the queue for the tram down is skipped.
route.pick: Peak Galleria (山顶广场) car park; the exact spot is agreed with the driver
route.drop: Near Lyndhurst Terrace and Central Market, at a stopping point the driver picks

route.title: Central–Mid-Levels Escalator (中环至半山自动扶梯)
route.walk: A few minutes' walk from the drop-off
route.desc: Billed as the world's longest outdoor covered escalator system; free. A short ride to Lyndhurst Terrace is enough.

route.title: Tai Cheong Bakery (泰昌饼家)
route.desc: Flaky-pastry egg tarts, eaten on the go.

food.name: Lan Fong Yuen (兰芳园)
food.desc: 2 Gage Street, ~1 min walk; credited with silk-stocking milk tea. One cup to go.

food.name: LINLEE, Lyndhurst Terrace (LINLEE（中环摆花街店）)

route.title: Ding Ding tram (叮叮车)
route.walk: Walk to Des Voeux Road Central to board
route.desc: Century-old tram. Upper deck front row for street views; ~20 min to Wan Chai. Paid by tapping a Wise card or Apple Pay when getting off.

route.title: Kam's Roast Goose (甘牌烧鹅)
route.walk: Get off on Hennessy Road, Wan Chai; 226 Hennessy Road
route.desc: Michelin-starred roast goose; the goose leg should be ordered. One or two plates are shared.
route.tip: Opens 11:30. After 14:00 it is quieter, but a queue is still possible.

food.name: Roast goose leg with rice (烧鹅腿饭)
food.desc: Regular goose rice can be upgraded to the leg

route.title: Capital Café (華星冰室)
route.desc: Well-known Hong Kong ice café: yuanyang or milk tea with scrambled-egg toast or a pineapple bun. Milk tea to go if it is full.

food.name: Yuanyang, milk tea (鸳鸯、奶茶)
food.desc: Coffee mixed with milk tea; the most Hong Kong drink

food.name: Scrambled-egg toast, pineapple bun with butter (炒蛋多士、菠萝油)

route.title: Star Ferry: Wan Chai → Tsim Sha Tsui (天星小轮)
route.walk: ~15 min walk to Wan Chai Pier (by the Convention Centre), or taxi ~5 min
route.desc: Century-old ferry; ~10 min across Victoria Harbour. Every ~12 min Mon–Sat. Tickets are bought by card at the pier's self-service machine.

route.title: Toys"R"Us, Ocean Terminal (海运大厦玩具反斗城)
route.walk: ~5 min walk from the pier, Ocean Terminal, Harbour City
route.desc: Flagship store revamped in 2026, with Pokémon, Tomica, Nintendo and Sanrio zones; each child picks one Hong Kong souvenir. Egg waffles (鸡蛋仔) can be bought near the pier on the way.
route.tip: Opens ~11:00; hours should be checked on the day.

route.title: Tsim Sha Tsui → West Kowloon Station
route.pick: Pick-up area outside Ocean Terminal, Harbour City; the exact spot is agreed with the driver
route.drop: West Kowloon Station private-car drop-off area

items.note: The van driver is contacted by WhatsApp; every pick-up and drop-off point is marked below. Between 13:15 and 15:45 the van is not needed and goes ahead to Tsim Sha Tsui.
items.tip: Vans are usually hired by the hour; hours, harbour-tunnel tolls and parking should be agreed first. Many Central streets are no-stopping zones, so exact pick-up and drop-off points are set by the driver.

notice: No Octopus card or coins needed. Ding Ding tram: a Wise card or Apple Pay is tapped when getting off; adult HK$3.3, child HK$1.6. Star Ferry: tickets are bought by card or QR at the pier's self-service machines; weekday adult HK$5.0, child HK$2.9. Foreign cards may incur cross-border fees.
